item.title: Why the Strait of Hormuz matters as Trump issues fresh ultimatum to Iran
item.summary: President Donald Trump gives Iran deadline to reopen Strait of Hormuz to all vessels or face strikes as oil, gas, diesel and jet fuel prices climb worldwide.

item.title: Iran war nears ‘completion’ as Trump eyes deadline — what the endgame could look like
item.summary: Trump warns Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz or face sweeping strikes on energy infrastructure as the conflict enters its endgame.

item.title: Trump fighting fierce battles, at home and abroad: Why he casually dismisses the consequences
item.summary: President Trump juggles an escalating Iran conflict and a wave of Cabinet firings, raising big questions about loyalty, strategy and consequences.

item.title: I lost my daughter to sanctuary policies. My senators are too cowardly to talk to me
item.summary: After losing his daughter Katie in a crash involving a previously deported driver, an Illinois father calls on leaders to confront sanctuary policies.

item.title: Pair of Democrat lawmakers slam 'blockade of fuel' to Cuba, 'economic bombing' after visit to island
item.summary: Reps. Pramila Jayapal and Jonathan Jackson said after a Congressional delegation to Cuba that U.S. economic restrictions on the island represented an "illegal U.S. blockade of fuel."

item.title: King Charles sparks backlash from UK Christians by not delivering an Easter message this year
item.summary: King Charles faces backlash from U.K. Christians for not giving an Easter message after he previously wished Muslims a blessed Ramadan, experts say.

item.title: New Hampshire suspect who shot officer and triggered massive manhunt killed in police gunfight
item.summary: Suspect who allegedly shot a New Hampshire police officer is killed in a gunfight after a massive manhunt that included a shelter-in-place order.

item.title: Baby among 3 dead in holiday horror as Easter egg hunt turns deadly
item.summary: Three people were killed after high winds knocked down a tree onto a group of people in Germany during an Easter egg hunt on Sunday morning, police said.

item.title: Fetterman says 'moral clarity' drives his widening break with the Democratic Party
item.summary: Sen. John Fetterman says moral clarity, not party politics, guides him as he describes a widening break with Democrats over Israel and the government shutdown.

item.title: NEWT GINGRICH: What Trump can teach us about energy and America’s future
item.summary: Rising AI and data center electricity demand requires expanded U.S. energy production as Trump and congressional Republicans realign policy.
